build_gpu_flat_index: build a GpuIndexFlat with StandardGpuResources to add and search float32 vectors using L2 metric
build_gpu_ivf_flat_index: build a GpuIndexIVFFlat index and train it on float32 vectors for GPU-accelerated IVF search
build_gpu_binary_flat_index: build a GpuIndexBinaryFlat index to add and search uint8 binary vectors on GPU
run_gpu_bruteforce_knn: run bfKnn with GpuDistanceParams to compute GPU brute-force k-NN on float32 or float16 vectors
run_gpu_kmeans: run faiss Kmeans with gpu=True to train GPU-accelerated k-means clustering on float32 data
